name: Gouda Toshirou
source:
Gouda is the head cook of [url=/c200]Kinzou's[/url] mansion. Unlike the other servants in the mansion, he had been hired by [url=/c367]Krauss[/url] and [url=/c680]Natsuhi[/url]. Due to this, his rank is very low. He is extremely proud of his culinary skills. 

He was previously employed at a hotel, and due to his experience, he is ostentatious and looks down upon [url=/c202]Shannon[/url] and [url=/c205]Kanon[/url]. However, while this seems apparent at first glance, he is actually quite concerned for them, and is very reliable when it counts.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Umineko_no_Naku_Koro_ni_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
